note: e0cb13a is NOT amended. The 20 qualification trials remain raw historical evidence; every correction below is an addition.

preregistration.requirement: the R3-A0 instruction required a Git commit containing fixture digests, model list, renderer, bounds, Nq, schedule and record schema BEFORE the first primary baseline run
preregistration.whatActuallyHappened: R3-A0 has ONE commit after the entire stage; the frozen plan was written to disk before the run but never committed as its own checkpoint
preregistration.executionLogOrderingSupports: the plan file (plan.json) was written before the first trial and its contents are consistent with pre-run preparation
preregistration.retroactiveClaim: none — this stage does NOT claim Git preregistration for R3-A0
preregistration.futureRule: an R3-A1 plan MUST be committed as its own commit before any primary fixture/model trial, and the results commit MUST descend from that plan commit

smokeTrial.recoverySource: the local qualification rig, which still holds the artifact
smokeTrial.orderEvidence: the artifact predates the 20-run matrix and the run directory is separate from the qualification runs directory; the smoke trial used the same fixture revision and model as the later q0 runs

priorClaimCorrected.correction: FALSE as written — one real-worker smoke trial ran on a primary fixture (F-A) before the 20-run matrix. The claim should have been: no behavioural pilot was run on F-B, and the one F-A smoke trial is recorded as an out-of-protocol pre-qualification smoke.

postOutcomeCorrection.what: the QC-2 implementation was changed AFTER the 20-run matrix had completed (the dimension set was widened from {classCoverage, fullSolve} to include the declared failure classes)
mitigatingFacts: the governing TEXTUAL QC-2 requirement already existed and said to prefer declared failure-class dimensions
the change attempted to align the executable code with that already-frozen text rather than to change the requirement
the pair verdicts did not change as a result of that change
postOutcomeCorrection.honestStatement: the executable analysis was NOT fully frozen before trial 1; this record does not pretend otherwise
postOutcomeCorrection.supersededBy: the R3-AE engine correction, which replaces the whole class-series path
